text: Allochiria or Allocheiria [Gr. alloV , elsewhere, + ceir , hand]: Ger. Allochirie ; Fr. allochirie ; Ital. allochiria . A disorder of tactile sensibility of central origin (see Janet, Nervoses et idées fixes ) in which a touch on one side of the body is felt and located on the opposite side. Also termed allaesthesia. ( J.J. )
